name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_physik_instrumente
title: PI GCS2 stage controller (PyMoDAQ PIWrapper)
intro: PI GCS2 stage controller (PyMoDAQ PIWrapper), adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_physik_instrumente. It reads `identity`, `axis_names`, `axis_units`, `positions` and 2 more; runs `move_absolute`, `move_relative`, `home_axis` and `stop_motion`. `move_absolute`: move one axis to an absolute position with the native move_absolute() and report the position the controller reads back. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
